For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.

Lately it's just been cut with minimal layering, all the same length ( no V at the back ), after washing in the mornings I towel dry, pin my ( in progress from blunt to sweeping ) fringe back and let the rest of my head dry on the bus, I get to work and it's dead straight albeit extremely flat and lifeless.

output.original_text: Lately it's just been cut with minimal layering, all the same length ( no V at the back ), after washing in the mornings I towel dry, pin my ( in progress from blunt to sweeping ) fringe back and let the rest of my head dry on the bus, I get to work and it's dead straight albeit extremely flat and lifeless.
output.joy: Lately, I've been enjoying a simple cut with minimal layering, all the same length (no V at the back). After washing in the mornings, I towel dry, pin my evolving fringe back, and let the rest of my hair dry on the bus. When I get to work, it's beautifully straight, though I wish it had more volume!
output.sadness: Lately it's just been cut with minimal layering, all the same length (no V at the back). After washing in the mornings, I towel dry, pin my fringe back that seems to be stuck in between styles, and let the rest of my hair dry on the bus. When I get to work, it’s dead straight but feels so flat and lifeless, which makes me a bit sad.
output.fear: Lately it's just been cut with minimal layering, all the same length (no V at the back). After washing in the mornings, I towel dry and pin my fringe back, letting the rest dry on the bus, but I dread arriving at work to find it dead straight and very flat and lifeless; what if everyone notices?
output.anger: Lately it's just been cut with minimal layering, all the same length (no V at the back), and I'm fed up! After washing in the mornings, I towel dry, pin my fringe back, and it just dries flat on the bus. When I get to work, it’s dead straight, and I'm furious that it looks so lifeless every day!
output.surprise: Lately it's just been cut with minimal layering, all the same length (no V at the back). After washing in the mornings, I towel dry, pin my fringe back, and let the rest of my hair dry on the bus. To my surprise, when I get to work, it’s dead straight but looks so flat and lifeless!
